original.statement: ServiceAccount annotations now support templating via the built-in Helm tpl function on both keys and values to facilitate workload identity configuration.

decision.reason: The linked PR's example puts the templated annotation under `serviceAccount: annotations:` [ev-8c1cb1cebce9]. That matches the values key path serviceAccount.annotations. The PR changes only the controller's templates/serviceaccount.yaml together with values.yaml [ev-08d4852e612a], so the subject is that one key and not other ServiceAccounts' keys. The release note says the existing annotation keys and values are now run through Helm `tpl` [ev-e7cf2f463686]. The configuration is unchanged but rendered differently, so behavior-changed is the right change type.
